cuts.title: Pokimane Left Stream And Came Back With Chicken From Two Places
cuts.hook: Pokimane left mid-stream and came back
cuts.retelling: Pokimane says 'and chicken', leaves her chair mid-stream, and comes back bragging that she got fried chicken from two different places.

cuts.label: joebartolozzi@vod2894517660/joebartolozzi-about-charact-2026w41
cuts.title: Joe Bartolozzi begs his editor to blur this GTA scene
cuts.hook: Joe begs his editor to blur GTA
cuts.retelling: Joe is playing GTA 5, gets stuck watching an awkward scene where the characters chat casually, begs his editor to blur it, then when the game cuts back to his character he panics about eye contact, keeps asking to shoot them, and runs.

cuts.label: kaicenat@vod2874428374/kaicenat-about-blue-2026w38
cuts.title: Kai Cenat DMed Bruce and got 'are you hacked?'
cuts.retelling: Kai thought of his estranged friend Bruce at a gas station, texted him, got 'are you hacked?' back, and then had a sincere dinner with him, but the cut stops before we learn whether they actually made up.

cuts.label: burn@momentnurturingrealeggwoop-eee1hwygln8ccoby/burn-about-casino-2026w41
cuts.title: Casino owner loses his best customer on purpose
cuts.hook: Tony asks the casino to ban him
cuts.retelling: A gambler named Tony asks the casino owner to ban him from playing, the owner agrees even though it will hurt his business, and a streamer confirms Tony is blocked, though only until tomorrow.

cuts.title: Kai lets two guests off, then gives the first detention ever
cuts.hook: Kai Cenat gives the first detention ever
cuts.retelling: Kai tells two guests they're fine, then learns a guest named Sin was vaping, and sends him to detention in the library, the first detention ever.
